sources.scope: Official INSEE national surname records of births in France, 1891–2000, with at least 30 occurrences.
INSEE-derived national CSV; 500 distinct high-attestation surnames, source spelling retained; redistribution terms to review.

2,500 next highest eligible national surname totals in historical INSEE 1891-2000 birth records (>=30 records). Genuine source surnames only. Birth registrations are not a 2026 resident-population census. Reuse license requires review.
